source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Fairly few driving restrictions of any kind actually applying to a client who has recently been diagnosed with a new seizure disorder by their provider","B":"Driving restrictions being essentially identical from one state to the next across the country, with fairly little regional variation in requirements","C":"The client being able to resume driving immediately after their diagnosis is made, without needing to observe any seizure-free waiting period first","D":"Most states have specific seizure-free interval requirements before driving is permitted, which vary by state and require reporting per state regulations"}}
source_row.rationale: Most states have specific seizure-free interval requirements before driving is legally permitted for individuals with a seizure disorder, though these specific requirements and reporting regulations vary by state, requiring the nurse to direct clients to their state's specific Department of Motor Vehicles regulations.
